name: hvac-digital-twin
//: Root task runner. Every command a developer needs is named here, so nothing has to be run by remembering an internal script path in the right order. Python steps require: numpy scipy matplotlib openpyxl.

scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:golden && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.calibrate: npm run calibrate:engine && npm run calibrate:tower && npm run calibrate:gordonng
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
